snippet.title: How to make a game NOT suck | Metro Gravity Devlog 1
snippet.description:
Wishlist Metro Gravity!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2986450/Metro_Gravity/ 

Join the discord!
https://discord.gg/RM5hktBqrv 

Other socials: https://linktr.ee/mrkogamedev

In this devlog, I show the staggering results of what just a few playtesters can have on the development of indie games.

These devlogs take a lot outta me man. But they still seem to be the best at helping me tell the story of what I love doing as well as bringing traffic to the game.

Maybe I'll start uploading to twitter? Who knows.
